items.title: Chase James on the Xi'an to Lhasa train
items.detail: Soft sleeper on Z165 or Z265 departing Xi'an 1 Oct was requested on 27 Jul. Asia Odyssey books Tibet trains about 15 days out - that window opened around 15 Sep. No ticket or confirmation on file. This is the single highest-risk item: without it there is no way into Lhasa on the 1st, and the whole Tibet leg shifts.

items.title: Correct the name on the Asia Odyssey traveller list
items.detail: James's traveller list reads 'Mr. Aaron Rock'. The passport reads BOCK. Tibet Travel Permits and Chinese rail tickets are both checked against the passport, so a wrong surname means being refused at the station or the Lhasa gate. Reply to AOT-BJ-James-50674 and get the corrected list back in writing.

items.title: Confirm the Tibet Travel Permit is in hand
items.detail: Foreign nationals cannot board a train or flight to Lhasa without the permit, and it is normally issued as a paper original delivered to the last hotel before Tibet - which for Aaron means The Westin Xi'an. Confirm AOT has the passport and visa scans they need, ask when it will be issued, and where it will be delivered. Nothing about the permit appears in the email record.

items.title: Confirm the Chinese visa and get the passport back
items.detail: Visa application confirmation was emailed to info@chinaatlanta.org (Consulate General of China in Atlanta) on 27 Jul asking them to confirm receipt and next steps. No reply is on file. Departure is weeks away and the permit application depends on the visa.

items.title: Decide on the Westin award night for 1 Oct
items.detail: Confirmation 84582237 holds 1-2 Oct at The Westin Xi'an on a free-night award, but the overnight train leaves Xi'an on the 1st. Free cancellation ends 23:59 on 17 Sep. Keep it only as a hedge against the train falling through - otherwise cancel and get the award night back.

items.title: Get the Tibet tour cost and payment schedule in writing
items.detail: No tour price, deposit or balance-due date appears anywhere in the email record - the figures were sent as image attachments. Ask James for a written quote and payment schedule. Jeff has already sent $1,000 by Zelle, so money is moving without a paper trail.

items.title: Confirm private versus group tour
items.detail: Amor dropped out, leaving five travellers. James said he needed to check with the Tibet department whether the group could still be upgraded to a private tour at that size. No answer on file.

items.title: Book Shanghai lodging, 10-15 Oct
items.detail: Five nights. Arriving Hongqiao late on the 10th, so somewhere easy to reach that night.

items.title: Book Los Angeles lodging, 22-27 Sep
items.detail: Five nights, starting a week from the 22nd. Nothing booked.

items.title: Note the Hongqiao / Pudong split
items.detail: MU 2336 lands at Shanghai Hongqiao; DL 38 leaves from Pudong. Different airports, about 50 km apart. Five days between them so it is not a connection risk, just a transfer to plan.

items.title: Enrol in STEP under your own account
items.detail: The shared reference sheet carries someone else's State Department STEP login. Register at step.state.gov with your own account so the Chengdu and Shanghai consulates can reach you.

items.title: Sort travel insurance
items.detail: Nothing on file. Worth checking what the Amex Platinum or Chase Sapphire Reserve already covers for trip interruption and medical evacuation - evacuation matters at 3,656 m.

items.title: Decide on the Zhangjiajie pre-tour
items.detail: Kamana floated a 3-day private Zhangjiajie trip - the Avatar mountains and Tianmen, with stay and meals - as a pre-Tibet add-on, and said Amor could join. Aaron's Xi'an dates leave no room for it as planned.

items.title: Pick seats on the Korean Air and China Eastern legs
items.detail: KE 012, KE 141 and MU 2336 all show no seat assigned. KE 012 is an 11-hour overnight, so worth doing early.
